verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs explicitly list GGUF as a supported quantization format alongside FP8, INT4, GPTQ/AWQ etc., confirming the capability exists, but the evidence pack lacks detailed GGUF-specific usage docs or hands-on confirmation, and one community comment notes vLLM historically lacked good support for popular quantization formats like 4-bit. missing for 10: dedicated GGUF loading tutorial/CLI example, independent hands-on report of successfully running a GGUF model in vLLM.
